tagline: Add Arasta live chat to your Magento store without touching the theme, recognise signed-in customers and link orders to the chats that led to them.
key_features: Arasta chat widget on every page, including checkout
Signed-in customers recognised with a signed token
Invoice PDFs for your Arasta agents
Settings per store view, secret stored encrypted

benefits.title: No theme edits
benefits.text: Paste the Store ID from your Arasta embed code into the settings. The module adds the widget to every page, on Luma and Hyvä.

benefits.title: Customers you can trust
benefits.text: Signed-in customers reach your agents with a short-lived token signed with your secret, so nobody can chat in someone else's name.

benefits.title: See which chats lead to orders
benefits.text: Orders placed after a chat are linked to the conversation and sent to Arasta with the order number, total and currency.

showcase.label: Storefront
showcase.title: The embed code, added for you
showcase.text: The same loader tag as Arasta's embed code, added once and asynchronously on every page, including the cart and checkout.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Native Hyvä template
showcase.text: Vanilla JavaScript with Hyvä private content, no RequireJS. For signed-in customers the signed token is added in the browser, never in cached pages.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: Four fields, per store view
showcase.text: Loader URL, Store ID, signing secret (stored encrypted) and token lifetime, with an Enabled switch for each store view.

showcase.label: REST API
showcase.title: One permission for the Arasta integration
showcase.text: Tick Arasta Live Chat API in the integration and Arasta can fetch your invoice PDFs and check which features your store supports.

feature_groups.title: Widget
items: Loader tag on every storefront page, including checkout
Loaded asynchronously, added once
Default loader URL prefilled
Different Store ID per store view
Enabled switch per store view

feature_groups.title: Customer identity
items: HS256 token with customer ID and email
Lifetime from 60 seconds to one hour
Expired tokens replaced in the browser
Private customer data, never in full-page cache
Guest cart ID for conversation tagging

feature_groups.title: Orders
items: Conversation ID stored on the cart and the order
Signed order link sent to Arasta at checkout
3-second timeout, never blocks the checkout
Failures logged, not shown to shoppers

feature_groups.title: Security
items: Signing secret stored encrypted and marked sensitive
HTTPS-only loader URL
Masked cart IDs never reach customer carts
Content Security Policy whitelist for app.arasta.io
Own ACL resources for settings and API

feature_groups.title: Integration
items: Invoice PDF endpoint (store's own template)
Version and capability endpoint
Public cart tagging endpoint for the widget
Upgrade path from platform/module-connector

feature_groups.title: Compatibility

PHP 8.2 to 8.5
Luma, Blank and child themes
